queer_characters.name: Alice Lamb
queer_characters.notes: Reclusive writer whose formative university romance with Vera shaped her life; the film gives her a central, sympathetic arc culminating in reunion with the woman she loved.

queer_characters.name: Vera
queer_characters.notes: Alice's university girlfriend; the text states she loved Alice and later reunites and lives with her. Notably she ended the relationship to pursue motherhood rather than due to societal taboo. No more specific label is supported by the source, so the queer umbrella is used.
